info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Charges API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

params.name: subsidiary_id
params.description: Subsidiary to be used when filtering data

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter charges updated after this timestamp

items.docs:
Pages card or out-of-pocket employee charges awaiting policy review, subsidiary allocation, or conversion into reimbursable payables.
Filter by subsidiary_id or updated.gt when syncing corporate card feeds into downstream expense automation.

params.name: charge_id
params.description: UUID of the charge to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Fetches a single charge with merchant metadata, amounts, and workflow state so reviewers can decide coding before reimbursement.
Use this after list-all-charges surfaces an id that needs manual inspection or attachment to a bill.

items.docs:
Drops a charge that should not influence spend reporting, for example duplicate imports from a card processor feed.
Ensure finance agrees the underlying bank activity will not be re-imported before removing the charge permanently.
